note: This file mirrors the /frontend-design skill. The skill is the single source of truth — if they ever differ, the skill wins. ACCTA design = professional, accessible, NEUTRAL-LED; action color is semantic (Floresta #166534 = positive primary, Carmesim #C7202F = brand identity + destructive). Light mode only.

design_philosophy.identity: ACCTA — institutional, professional, accessible (Swiss Modernism: strict hierarchy, one accent, high contrast, no decoration for its own sake)
core_principles: Neutral foundation carries ~90% of the UI; action color is semantic — Floresta #166534 is the positive primary, Carmesim #C7202F is brand identity + destructive, both used sparingly
Most buttons and surfaces are neutral; red is an event, not a background
WCAG 2.1 AA is a hard floor (AAA for body text where achievable)
Clarity over conversion — internal portal, strict visual hierarchy
anti_patterns: No dark mode (disabled by design decision) and no flat black backgrounds
No Carmesim/red text on dark, Navy, colored or photographic backgrounds — the legibility bug
No making every button red — red = destructive only; the positive Primary is Floresta green and rare; everything else is neutral; never Carmesim as a positive primary
No accent on large surfaces; no color used as the only signal (pair with icon/text)
No text lighter than #6B7280; no more than 2 font weights per section
No font other than Open Sans (JetBrains Mono only for code/IDs)
No custom UI primitives (use shadcn/ui); no inline styles (Tailwind only)
No non-Portuguese user-facing text; no 'inadimplente' member status

rules: Open Sans for headings and body; max 2 font weights per section
JetBrains Mono only for code, IDs, dates and numeric data points
Body min 16px on mobile; line-height 1.5-1.7; line-length 65-75ch
Muted/caption text never lighter than #6B7280 (>=4.5:1 on white)

action_positive.usage: Positive primary action. The ONE primary positive button per view (Guardar, Confirmar, Criar, Aprovar, Entrar, Votar), white text 6.2:1. <Button variant='primary'> / primaryBtn.

brand_accent.usage: Brand identity + destructive. Allowed: active/selected nav indicator, links on white (underlined), focus ring, logo, error highlights, and destructive actions (outline by default: bg-white border-[#C7202F] text-[#C7202F] hover:bg-[#FBEAEC]; solid #C7202F only inside an irreversible confirm dialog). FORBIDDEN: a positive primary (use Floresta), body text, the fill of secondary/every button, text on any dark/colored/photo surface, large background areas.

neutral.usage: Neutral foundation carries ~90% of the UI. Grafite #3A3A3A ~9:1 on white (AAA).

structural_restricted.usage: ONLY for public/marketing hero depth or a deliberate dark band, ALWAYS with white text (never red text on it). Not used in portal chrome. Not a second accent.

semantic.usage: Always pair with an icon + text label — never convey state by color alone. Error message text uses #B91C1C; a destructive button fill uses brand #C7202F.

allowed_contrast_pairs: Semantic -700 text on its matching tint or white
rules: STRICT LIGHT MODE ONLY. Backgrounds #FFFFFF, secondary surfaces #F5F5F5, cards #FFFFFF.
Carmesim is a signal, not wall paint — at most ONE prominent Carmesim instance per view.
Every text/background pair must be an allowed pair and reach 4.5:1 (3:1 for >=24px or >=18.66px bold).
Never red text on dark/Navy/colored/photo backgrounds.

surfaces.card: bg-white rounded-lg border border-[#E5E7EB] shadow-sm p-6

public_portal.sections: Hero > value/news > features > CTA > footer (one Carmesim CTA)

private_dashboard.sidebar: Light surface, 270px expanded / 72px collapsed; active item = Carmesim left-border indicator

buttons.rule: Action color is semantic: green = positive, red = destructive. Never more than one Primary (Floresta-filled) button per view/section. Default to Secondary; promote only the single main positive action to Primary. Carmesim is no longer a positive primary.
buttons.primary: bg-[#166534] text-white hover:bg-[#14532D] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-semibold (positive: Guardar/Confirmar/Criar/Aprovar/Entrar/Votar; variant='primary' / primaryBtn)
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#D1D5DB] text-[#3A3A3A] hover:bg-[#F5F5F5] rounded-md px-4 py-2
buttons.destructive: default outline: bg-white border border-[#C7202F] text-[#C7202F] hover:bg-[#FBEAEC] (variant='destructive' / destructiveBtn). Solid bg-[#C7202F] text-white (variant='destructiveSolid') ONLY inside an irreversible confirm dialog.

cards.default: bg-white rounded-lg border border-[#E5E7EB] shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

components.inputs: border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-md px-3 py-2; focus ring as borders.focus; use shadcn/ui form + Zod + toast

data_display.status_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium — icon + label + semantic color (never color alone)
data_display.table: header bg-[#F5F5F5] text-[#6B7280] uppercase text-xs; row hover bg-[#F5F5F5]; selected row bg-[#FBEAEC]

digital_wallet.style: Member ID card. Aspect ratio 1.586, rounded-xl. Neutral surface with Carmesim accent details only.
digital_wallet.states: Active = full color; Inactive = grayscale. Status shown with icon + label, not color alone.

motion.preferences: prefers-reduced-motion aware; subtle and professional — no layout-shifting hovers, no flashy motion

effects.page_enter: initial={{opacity:0, y:20}} animate={{opacity:1, y:0}} transition={{duration:0.3, ease:'easeOut'}}

accessibility.standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (AAA for body text where achievable)
accessibility.contrast_check: Every text/bg pair must be an allowed_contrast_pair and >=4.5:1 (3:1 large). White text on #166534/#C7202F/#1e3a5f/semantic solids. Never red text on dark.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus-visible ring on ALL interactive elements (ring-2 ring-[#C7202F]/40 ring-offset-2). Never outline-none without a replacement.
accessibility.color_independence: Status/meaning must use icon + text in addition to color

instructions_to_main_agent: The /frontend-design skill is canonical — consult it for any UI work; this JSON mirrors it.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons (SVG only; never emojis as icons).
Use 'framer-motion' for the motion specs above; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Use 'recharts' for dashboard analytics with an accessible palette anchored on brand tokens.
Build on shadcn/ui (New York) primitives; Tailwind only; all user-facing text in Portuguese.
Strictly separate Public Layout (marketing) and Private Layout (dashboard/sidebar).
universal_guidelines: Default every control to neutral; promote only the single main positive action to the Floresta Primary (#166534); destructive = outline Carmesim, solid only in a confirm dialog.
Verify every text/background pair against allowed_contrast_pairs before delivering.
Never use Carmesim/red as text on dark, Navy, colored or photographic backgrounds.
Create depth through layered neutral surfaces + subtle shadow, not heavy color.
You MUST NOT apply a universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`).
Components MUST use named exports; pages MUST use default exports.
